name: Savings USDD
oneLiner: sUSDD is the TRON DAO Reserve's savings wrapper of USDD; share price accrues savings yield while final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: sUSDD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

collateral: USDD deposited into the USDD savings system; sUSDD remains economically backed by USDD while savings yield accrues through the wrapper exchange rate
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDD to receive sUSDD, whose value appreciates versus USDD as savings yield accrues; final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics

mintAuthority.summary: sUSDD is an immutable DSR-style savings wrapper (SavingsUsdd, forked from DAI Foundation) over USDD. The contract has no owner, no admin, no proxy — all parameters are immutable (pot, usddJoin set at constructor). Shares are minted/burned only by deposit/withdrawal of USDD. Base USDD mint authority is inherited from reviewed usdd-tron-dao-reserve.

controls.label: sUSDD Ethereum wrapper (SavingsUsdd, immutable)
controls.capDescription: Immutable DSR-style savings wrapper over deposited USDD; no admin, no proxy, no upgrade path. Shares minted/burned only by deposit/withdraw.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295198, no EIP-1967 proxy slots (impl=0x0, admin=0x0), no owner(), no DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Source code (Blockscout) confirmed contractName=SavingsUsdd; constructor sets immutable pot and usddJoin; no admin functions. asset() returned USDD 0x4f8e5de400de08b164e7421b3ee387f461becd1a. BSC contract 0x8ba9da757d1d66c58b1ae7e2ed6c04087348a82d is same bytecode pattern (22172 bytes, no proxy).

controls.label: Inherited USDD privileged token mint/admin authority

review.evidence: Wrapper surface verified at Ethereum block 25295198 and BSC block 103632491: SavingsUsdd is an immutable DAI-Foundation-fork DSR contract with no owner, no proxy, no upgrade path. asset() confirmed USDD 0x4f8e5de... on both chains. Base USDD mint authority tracked under usdd-tron-dao-reserve.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sUSDD is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
